assertion.statement: From Kafka 4.0.0, the JMXReporter is only enabled if metrics are enabled in .spec.kafka.metrics or JMXReporter is explicitly added in metric.reporters.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Text does not state how the Kafka version and metrics settings combine for an environment; exposure depends on the Kafka version in use and on whether JMX metrics are relied on.; consequence: Text says JMXReporter must be enabled explicitly but does not state what happens if the operator does nothing.
